scope: 已审阅手动输入/h5交付、IPCCH云v1、FEWS云及本地实验的架构相关契约；不是全部技能/模板/历史文档的有效规则全集。v3未入Git规范另见architecture.json约束和阅读说明。实现合规/实际部署未验证。

rules.name: 改符号前分析上游影响
rules.anchor: **MUST run impact analysis before editing any symbol.**
rules.explanation: 列出调用方、流程和风险；HIGH/CRITICAL先告知。
rules.verification: 运行impact并核对当前源码；本次不改实现

rules.name: 提交前核对实际影响
rules.anchor: **MUST run `detect_changes()` before committing**
rules.explanation: 核对diff影响的符号和流程。
rules.verification: detect_changes与git diff对照

rules.name: 填充配置及凭据保留本地
rules.anchor: Local filled config files such as
rules.explanation: 共享模板，配置值不写入公共产物。
rules.verification: 检查模板与忽略项；不读取密钥

rules.name: 云角色分离且最小权限
rules.anchor: - Split service accounts for Cloud Run
rules.explanation: 编排、Batch和Vertex使用不同服务账户。
rules.verification: 核对manifest及实际IAM；本轮未查云IAM

rules.name: 统一area_id年月键
rules.anchor: The standardized model input is one row per
rules.explanation: IPCCH模型输入按area_id/year/month唯一；admin_code是兼容别名。
rules.verification: 运行model-input-forecast schema校验

rules.name: 生产只需目标月scaffold
rules.anchor: Production only needs the target month scaffold
rules.explanation: 不强迫月度生产准备多月scaffold。
rules.verification: 核对目标年月和唯一空间集合

rules.name: 预测输入不要求真实标签
rules.anchor: For prediction runs, outcome columns are not part
rules.explanation: 标签待真实发布，不填造预测月outcome。
rules.verification: 检查标签没有被虚构或作为强制预测输入

rules.name: IPCCH云v1仅EVI与纯推理
rules.anchor: Cloud v1 must not invoke local workstation scoring
rules.explanation: 禁止此路径调用训练、其它遥感族、地图/表格完整交付或非Vertex推理；不是全仓禁训。
rules.verification: 核对调用链与forbidden-side-effect inventory

rules.name: 云运行镜像使用digest
rules.anchor: Use the returned `@sha256:...` reference
rules.explanation: 可变tag不是发布身份。
rules.verification: 输入manifest镜像以@sha256绑定

rules.name: 输入引用须可核验
rules.anchor: Every required GCS artifact must have a checksum
rules.explanation: SHA256、generation/version或manifest内明确批准的waiver。
rules.verification: 运行manifest/schema与对象引用校验

rules.name: 每次运行只选一个月
rules.anchor: **Scale/Scope**: Exactly one
rules.explanation: 一个feature_month与run_id，scaffold为行集合权威；不含历史回放。
rules.verification: 核对CLI/manifest月份及输出键集合

rules.name: 重复run_id不得改已有前缀
rules.anchor: Use a unique `RUN_ID`. Duplicate run ids
rules.explanation: 先获取独占run前缀，冲突即失败。
rules.verification: 验证create-only sentinel和冲突测试

rules.name: 分配新run前验证镜像代码身份
rules.anchor: Before allocating a new `run_id`, verify
rules.explanation: 实现commit、镜像build记录和manifest digest一致。
rules.verification: 核对构建attestation与完整SHA

rules.name: EVI保持scaffold空间全集
rules.anchor: - Preserve one row per scaffold area.
rules.explanation: 区域统计不可丢失空间单位。
rules.verification: 核对几何/scaffold集合和输出area键

rules.name: rasterio采用all_touched=false
rules.anchor: - Run rasterio extraction with `all_touched=false`.
rules.explanation: 保持约定像元包含规则。
rules.verification: 核对mask参数及参考比较

rules.name: EVI缺失或超时须失败
rules.anchor: - Exit nonzero on missing raster
rules.explanation: 缺栅格、无效schema、超时或重试耗尽不得当成功。
rules.verification: 检查worker错误报告/退出状态

rules.name: 不得用validate-only替代推理
rules.anchor: - Must not pass `--validate-only`.
rules.explanation: 输入校验不是模型推理。
rules.verification: 核对执行参数和三份prediction CSV

rules.name: Vertex必须禁用地图
rules.anchor: - Must pass `--no-map`.
rules.explanation: 云推理只产出契约CSV和报告。
rules.verification: 检查实际CLI参数及产物库存

rules.name: 发布指针最后CAS写入
rules.anchor: - Write `released/{YYYYMM}/release_manifest.json` last
rules.explanation: 产物先完成，generation条件更新稳定入口。
rules.verification: 测试generation冲突时旧指针不变

rules.name: 终态运行证据不可改写
rules.anchor: Run evidence must not be modified after terminal status.
rules.explanation: 修订需新运行，保留旧证据。
rules.verification: 核对版本前缀与对象generation

rules.name: 消费者先读release manifest
rules.anchor: - read `release_manifest.json` first
rules.explanation: 按记录的路径/checksum读取，不凭目录文件数判断完成。
rules.verification: 核对read_release_manifest路径

rules.name: 人口估计字段不替换模型特征
rules.anchor: same immutable model package. population_estimate is output-only
rules.explanation: population_estimate供输出；模型仍使用estimated_population。
rules.verification: 核对feature contract及输入矩阵

rules.name: 阈值距离标签不是置信区间
rules.anchor: label is qualitative distance-to-threshold stability
rules.explanation: decision_margin只衡量当前阈值距离，h5修订可禁用该输出。
rules.verification: 检查字段解释与阈值边界

rules.name: FEWS与IPCCH云资源隔离
rules.anchor: It does not create an online Vertex Endpoint.
rules.explanation: FEWS Batch-only；不得混用IPCCH模型/发布根。
rules.verification: 核对deployment roots及Endpoint inventory

rules.name: 三预测期作为统一云套件
rules.anchor: The suite uses exactly one Vertex AI Custom Job
rules.explanation: 一个训练job、三个parent/version、三个精确版本Batch；h5不自动加入云suite。
rules.verification: 核对0m/6m/12m job/model资源清单

rules.name: 保留原panel并绑定规范化audit
rules.anchor: - Never overwrite the raw assembled FEWSNET panel.
rules.explanation: 规范化写新CSV与匹配audit，不能复用旧checksum。
rules.verification: 检查原始hash及新CSV/audit一致

rules.name: 三production alias须协调发布
rules.anchor: - Do not manually move one production alias
rules.explanation: 部分移动需回滚；不可手工改单一alias/pointer。
rules.verification: 核对promotion与冲突恢复证据

rules.name: gcloud与Python身份须一致
rules.anchor: Do not continue if either target differs.
rules.explanation: 后续云操作必须保持已验证的服务账户impersonation。
rules.verification: 核对CLI和ADC principal，不输出token

rules.name: 生产验收需完整16项证据
rules.anchor: Do not call the first production run accepted until
rules.explanation: 本地测试、跳过smoke或成功构建都不是生产验收。
rules.verification: 运行runbook验收器；本轮不执行

rules.name: 36个实际标签月按30/6拆分
rules.anchor: Training uses the latest 36 distinct target periods
rules.explanation: 不是连续36日历月；前30拟合填补/临时模型，后6选阈值，36重拟合。
rules.verification: 核对实际target period/key账本和fit统计

rules.name: local包不得直接注册生产
rules.anchor: is not the digest-pinned `fewsnet-model-package-v1`
rules.explanation: 共享模型算法不代表local包符合云包身份契约。
rules.verification: 核对package schema、image digest及runtime versions

rules.name: FEWS本地保持依赖版本
rules.anchor: keeps `scikit-learn==1.8.0`
rules.explanation: 保留imbalanced-learn==0.14.0及既有兼容桥。
rules.verification: 核对requirements和加载器版本校验

rules.name: h5按五个日历月连接
rules.anchor: 按 polygon 身份和日历月份连接
rules.explanation: 禁止行位移；训练target<=2026-04，训练feature最多2025-11。
rules.verification: 逐行核对feature/target keys与cutoff

rules.name: 截止月份不等于历史可得性
rules.anchor: 月份 cutoff 约束观测和标签所指月份
rules.explanation: 使用当前历史修订值重建April输入；不是严格当时可得数据回测。
rules.verification: 核对来源获取commit/时间和观测截止

rules.name: 更新仅替换实际覆盖键
rules.anchor: 在可更新键内用重新计算的整组指标替换旧值
rules.explanation: 保留未覆盖旧值；缺失不等于零，不清空整段历史。
rules.verification: 按键比较替换/保留和非更新列

rules.name: 保留两模型不同WFP定义
rules.anchor: - WFP 保留各自最新 assembled 输入的定义
rules.explanation: FEWS用月价格百分比变化均值+100；IPCCH用Trend均值+100；不拟合新scaler。
rules.verification: 核对同序列前日历月、单位证据及覆盖审计

rules.name: 保留原生边界与字符串ID
rules.anchor: | 各模型 `polygons.geojson`
rules.explanation: EPSG:4326，不重新分区/裁剪/简化；两模型空间全集分别校验。
rules.verification: 核对CSV/GeoJSON/mapping键一致

rules.name: IPCCH原始回归分数不裁剪
rules.anchor: - 原有累计占比分数为回归输出
rules.explanation: 保留超界或非单调raw scores并报告；原0.2/cummax解码不变。
rules.verification: 核对有限数、超界报告和离散解码

rules.name: 人口权重与Census参考分开
rules.anchor: 两表均保留 Census `referenced_population`
rules.explanation: Census不作加权均值分母；区域分散度不是置信区间。
rules.verification: 独立重算均值、权重和支持数

rules.name: 危机概率不是危机人口比例
rules.anchor: 人口加权危机概率不能改称为危机人口占比
rules.explanation: FEWS的概率均值不能直接解释为需要援助人数。该原规格不新增国家分类的限制已被v3本地规格覆盖，概率含义仍保留。
rules.verification: 核对输出codebook及字段文案

rules.name: 评分必须先重加载交付模型
rules.anchor: 模型运行所需代码和依赖清单随交付提供
rules.explanation: 交付内相对路径；重加载不能依赖外部checkout、云凭据或训练内存。
rules.verification: 异地临时目录重加载并比较全部预测

rules.name: 新交付目录不得覆盖旧结果
rules.anchor: - 保留原始和旧版本文件。
rules.explanation: 新模型、输入和预测采用独立版本目录。
rules.verification: 比较原版本hash和新目录成员

rules.name: 异地重评分须数值一致
rules.anchor: 7. 在不同的临时目录中重新加载完整交付包
rules.explanation: 连续值rtol=0/atol=1e-12，类别精确一致。
rules.verification: 运行focused verification及relocation检查
